title: How to Access AMP Data (Sept. 2026 Revisions)

SysBio FAIRplex aims to enable access to Accelerating Medicines Partnership® (AMP® ) Program data, which each AMP Project manages independently. This guide provides an overview of the registration and data access requirements for the AMPs that are part of the B release.

Summary of AMP Projects

AMP AD

Data Host:
AD Knowledge Portal 

Data Access Instructions

AMP AD focuses on discovering new drug targets and developing biomarkers to track disease progression and treatment response. Data generated through AMP AD is managed via the Synapse platform developed by Sage Bionetworks. A web portal interface called the AD Knowledge Portal is used to explore and access data in the Synapse platform. The AD Knowledge Portal distributes data from a variety of Alzheimer's and Related Dementia programs, not limited to AMP AD.

AMP PDRD

Data Host:
AMP PDRD Knowledge Portal 

Data Access Instructions

The AMP PDRD focus is on identifying and validating the most promising biological targets for therapeutics,and accelerating the development of novel therapies for Parkinson’s Disease and other related disorders. Data in AMP PDRD is hosted on Terra, with a public knowledge portal to explore summary statistics of participant demographics and data offerings. AMP PDRD has partnered with The Global Parkinson’s Genetics Program (GP2) and offers access to harmonized AMP AD data and federated data (GP2) through a single Data Use Agreement.

AMP RA/SLE and AMP AIM

Data Host:
AMP AIM ARK Portal

Data Access Instructions

AMP RA/SLE and AMP AIM focus on understanding cellular and molecular interactions that lead to autoimmune diseases and related diseases. AMP RA/SLE and AMP AIM are managed via the Synapse platform developed by Sage Bionetworks. A web portal interface called the ARK Knowledge Portal is used to explore and access data in the Synapse platform.

AMP SCZ

Data Host:
AMP SCZ Knowledge Portal

Data Access Instructions

AMP SCZ aims to develop effective treatments for people with schizophrenia and related mental health conditions and disseminates research data to the broader scientific community through the NIMH Data Archive platform (NDA).

AMP T2D

Data Host - Summary Data:
AMP T2D Knowledge Portal
 
Data Host - Individual level Data:
Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas

AMP T2D is a completed AMP project which used and supplemented available human genetic data from individuals with Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) to identify and validate novel molecules and pathways as targets for therapeutic development. Data in AMP T2D is stored in the Type 2 Diabetes Knowledge Portal (T2DKP), which provides summary level genetic and genomic data from over 1.5 million individuals with type 2 diabetes. Individual level data from AMP T2D is available through the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas (CMDGA) All data is public access.

AMP CMD

Data Host - Summary Data:
AMP CMD Knowledge Portal
 
Data Host - Individual level Data:
Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas

AMP CMD builds on the work of its predecessor AMP T2D. AMP CMD aims at identifying promising new targets for six common metabolic diseases: liver diseases such as nonalcoholic steatohepatitis, kidney diseases, obesity, cardiovascular diseases, type 2 diabetes/prediabetes, and type 1 diabetes. Summary level data are accessed from AMP CMD consortium members and other collaborating researchers, and made available on the Common Metabolic Diseases Knowledge Portal (CMDKP). Individual level data is available through the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas (CMDGA). All data is public access.

Requesting Access To AMP Data (Sept. 2026 Revisions)

SysBio FAIRplex aims to enable access to Accelerating Medicines Partnership® (AMP®) Program data, which each AMP Project independently manages. This guide provides an overview of data and data access and registration requirements across AMP Projects in the Beta release. Note that each project may have more data than what is intended to be included in the SysBio FAIRplex harmonization effort.
